questions.text: Eric The traffic's awful but I'm almost there. Luckily I ordered the tickets online so we won't need to waste time queuing. Let me know where to find you when I get to the theatre. Anne | Why is Anne texting?

options.label: A
options.text: to ask Eric if he can do her a favour

options.label: B
options.text: to remind Eric about what they have agreed

options.label: C
options.text: to give Eric an update regarding their arrangement

questions.explanation:
Anne 说 “The traffic's awful but I'm almost there... ordered tickets online”（交通拥堵但快到了，已网购票），目的是告知 Eric 当前进展，对应 C 选项 “give an update regarding their arrangement”（更新约定相关情况）。
A 选项 “ask a favour”（请求帮助）和 B 选项 “remind what they agreed”（提醒约定内容）均未体现。

questions.text: Final-year Students Ex-students from our course are coming here next week to talk to you about how to do well in your first job. Space for a maximum of thirty students, so sign up now.

options.label: A
options.text: Students of any year group are able to come to the careers talk.

options.label: B
options.text: Students should go to the talk if they need help applying for a job.

options.label: C
options.text: Students must register quickly because places at the event are limited.

questions.explanation:
通知提到 “Space for a maximum of thirty students, so sign up now”（最多 30 人，立即报名），对应 C 选项 “must register quickly because places are limited”（因名额有限需快速注册）。
A 选项 “any year group can come”（任何年级都可参加）错误，仅限 “Final-year Students”（毕业班）；B 选项 “need help applying for a job”（申请工作需帮助）错误，讲座主题是 “how to do well in first job”（如何在第一份工作中表现出色）。

questions.text: Recycling Centre Users Glass, plastic and metal items must be cleaned before you bring them to the recycling centre. Please place them in the correct recycling bin - the recycling centre staff are there to help.

options.label: A
options.text: Recycling centre staff will clean items for recycling.

options.label: B
options.text: Certain items need to be washed before they are recycled.

options.label: C
options.text: All items can be placed in the same recycling bin.

questions.explanation:
规定提到 “Glass, plastic and metal items must be cleaned before bringing to the recycling centre”（玻璃、塑料、金属物品需清洗后再带来），对应 B 选项 “certain items need to be washed before recycling”（某些物品需清洗）。
A 选项 “staff will clean items”（工作人员会清洗）与原文矛盾，C 选项 “all items in same bin”（所有物品放同一箱）错误，要求 “place in correct bin”（放入正确回收箱）。

questions.text: Nora You know the silent disco we spoke about? You've got to wear their special headphones so you can hear the DJ. Besides you, who else should I get tickets for? They're running out! Gabriel

options.label: A
options.text: Gabriel has got a ticket for Nora to go to the special dance event.

options.label: B
options.text: Gabriel is informing Nora that she needs to remember to bring headphones.

options.label: C
options.text: Gabriel wants Nora to suggest who may be interested in going to the disco.

questions.explanation:
Gabriel 问 “Besides you, who else should I get tickets for? They're running out!”（除了你，还该给谁买票？票快没了），对应 C 选项 “wants Nora to suggest who may be interested”（让 Nora 推荐感兴趣的人）。
A 选项 “has got a ticket for Nora”（已给 Nora 买票）错误，还在询问；B 选项 “inform Nora to bring headphones”（提醒 Nora 带耳机）是事实陈述，而非主要目的。

questions.text: If you need information about the ingredients in any of our dishes, please tell your waiter when you are choosing food from our menu.

options.label: A
options.text: Our staff can let you know about what we've used to make our dishes.

options.label: B
options.text: Read the information on our menu if you need to avoid eating certain ingredients.

options.label: C
options.text: Tell your waiter if you’d prefer something different from what's on the menu.

questions.explanation:
提示说 “if you need information about ingredients, tell your waiter when choosing food”（需要食材信息，点餐时告知服务员），对应 A 选项 “staff can let you know about dish ingredients”（员工可告知菜品食材）。
B 选项 “read information on menu”（看菜单信息）错误，原文说 “tell your waiter”；C 选项 “tell waiter if you prefer something different”（想换菜告知服务员）与原文 “ingredients information” 无关。
